Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of QCOM.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.41 per share.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2021.
Our cloud segment grew 24% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 24% to 9% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $48.1 billion this quarter, representing 24% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
